title: The Customer filter sits between Sales Type and Location
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Customer in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Customer filter sits between the Sales Type filter and the Location filter.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Sales By Customer spec, S18-R1: “The toolbar has a Customer filter, labeled "Customer," positioned between the Sales Type filter and the Location filter.”
